title: Being at-worst-nodal of relative dimension 1 is stable under base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

difficulty_reason: The lemma records the base-change stability of the nodal-curves property (at-worst-nodal of relative dimension 1) for morphisms of algebraic spaces — the permission slip used whenever the chapter's family-of-nodal-curves arguments base change the family. The retained proof is written by double citation: the deformation-theoretic remark fixing the normal-form behaviour of nodes under field extension (Morphisms of Spaces, remark base-change-P — the completed-local-ring dictionary for nodal points) plus the curves-chapter algebra lemma (Algebraic Curves, lemma base-change-nodal-family: the standard form xy = a is preserved under arbitrary base change of the ground ring because the node discriminant equation pulls back unchanged) jointly cover every point of a putative base change; the author supplies the composition and nothing else is claimed. Retained author proof at lines 13312-13317.
